programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Aparentemente, Dark Wing, un monstruo que hizo un pacto con Ren (Kamen Rider Knight), atacó a un niño, pero ¿fue eso realmente?

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.sub-title: El Hombre Misterioso de la Tienda de Antigüedades
programme.desc: Aparece un tercer Rider: Kamen Rider Scissors. Ren sospecha que Tomoyuki Kaga, dueño de una tienda de antigüedades, es la verdadera identidad de Scissors y busca su paradero.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: La pista de regreso a Tijeras que estaba siguiendo Ren no funcionó. Yui recibe la visita de un policía, pero...

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.sub-title: El Surgimiento de un Nuevo Tipo
programme.desc: La tía de Yui, Sanako, quien también es propietaria de Atori, ha regresado de un largo viaje al extranjero. A Sanako, al conocer a Ren, no le gusta y lo interrumpe.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Sanako, la tía de Yui a la que le gusta mucho Shinji, intenta convencer a los tres (Ren, Yui y Shinji) de que vivan juntos, pero Ren no acepta el acercamiento de Shinji a Yui.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Shimada Nanako, el genio informático del ORE Journal, ha sido secuestrado. Shinji recibe instrucciones de encargarse de este incidente y persigue al secuestrador en una casa abandonada en las montañas.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Ren se lesiona en la pelea contra Zolda (Shuichi Kitaoka). Más tarde, Shuichi intenta usar su posición como abogado para mantener a Shinji en la cárcel, pero Ren y sus colegas lo detienen, evitando que detenga su trampa.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: El "Final Vent" del Kamen Rider Zolda posee un poder altamente destructivo... Ren es arrojado de vuelta al mundo real con gran intensidad, golpeando su cabeza y perdiendo repentinamente la memoria.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Mientras Ren se dirige hacia la Universidad Seimeiin en su motocicleta, pequeños fragmentos de recuerdos del pasado vuelven a su mente.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Ren, con sus recuerdos restaurados y su voluntad de luchar renovada, se enfrenta a un hombre misterioso.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Zolda sufrió un contraataque de Ryuki y fue derrotado. Shinji, quien derrotó a un Rider por primera vez, tiene esto fijo en su mente y tiene la intención de dejar de ser un Rider.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.sub-title: La Leyenda de las Máscaras de Hierro
programme.desc: Miyuki tiene una visión: una batalla entre el nuevo Kamen Rider y Knight, pero Ren no quiere escuchar las palabras de Miyuki.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Knight y Raia siguen a Ryuki al Mundo Espejo y se dan cuenta de que Kamen Rider Gai (Jun Shibaura) le ha robado la tarjeta de contrato de Ryuki.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Knight toma ventaja sobre Gai y lo acorrala, pero no puede derrotarlo. En el estado en el que se encuentra Ren, Tezuka asume que ha renunciado a ser un Rider y considera que ese punto será su perdición.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.sub-title: El Rider que Escapó de la Prisión
programme.desc: El abogado de Takeshi Asakura, Shuichi Kitaoka, decidió abandonar el caso de Takeshi debido a su comportamiento atroz. Poco después, Shiro Kanzaki aparece en la celda de Takeshi.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Takeshi Asakura está en un restaurante con varias personas y toma a una de ellas como rehén.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Kamen Rider Gai (Jun Shibaura) es derrotado por Kamen Rider Ouja (Takeshi Asakura), y poco después comienza una batalla entre Ryuki y Ouja, aunque el que empezó todo antes fue Ren (Knight).

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Knight se ha aliado momentáneamente con Ouja y lucha contra Ryuki. Junto a Takeshi, Ren una vez más arriesga todo en esta pelea.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Tezuka se encuentra con Shiro Kanzaki en la antigua residencia de Kanzaki. Shiro presiona a Tezuka con una pregunta a Tezuka, por qué no pelea. Poco después, Shiro le da una carta peculiar con las palabras "Survive", lo que implica que sobrevive.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Goro fue secuestrado por Takeshi Asakura, mientras Zolda se dirige a la batalla contra Knight, tratando de ocultar cierta perturbación en sus convicciones.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Kamen Rider Raia es derrotado antes del ataque de Kamen Rider Ouja. Ouja también sufre un fuerte ataque de Ren, quien se encontraba en su nueva forma, Knight Survive, logrando apenas huir hacia su escondite.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Shiro Kanzaki declara que la batalla de los Jinetes está en espera. Shinji y Ren pierden su capacidad de transformarse y no tienen más remedio que hacer lo que dice Shiro...

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: La esperanza de Shinji de que incluso Takeshi Asakura pueda cambiar se va por el desagüe.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Ren deja de ver a Eri, cuya salud cambia repentinamente, para ir a pelear. Yui, consciente de la determinación de Ren, lo desafía a un enfrentamiento contra su propio hermano, Shiro Kanzaki.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Odín, el 13º jinete, usó su carta, el "Time Vent". Shinji se da cuenta de que está en el pasado, hasta que el tiempo se asienta en febrero de 2002.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.sub-title: Batalla por la Causa de Los Encuentros
programme.desc: Reiko termina aceptando una oferta de matrimonio arreglado, y tan pronto como hace oficial la propuesta, es perseguida por un acosador y desaparece sin dejar rastro.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: La exsecretaria de Shuichi Kitaoka, Megumi Asano, decide demandarlo por romper el compromiso de compromiso que hicieron en el pasado. Shinji parece estar emocionado, mientras que Reiko está completamente indignada.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Mika Hamasaki es una niña que sobrevivió sola en una balsa a la deriva sin tripulación. Ella afirma haber visto tres monstruos...

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Takeshi Asakura ya no puede dominar a los tres monstruos con los que hizo un pacto. Ren y Kitaoka creen en la autodestrucción de Asakura.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Megumi, ahora reportera del ORE Journal, le dice a Shinji que lo vio "salir de un espejo", y desde que eso ocurrió, Megumi se ha convertido básicamente en la sombra de Shinji, persiguiéndolo donde quiera que vaya.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Reiko decide ir a la Universidad Seimeiin en busca de pistas sobre "Shiro Takami", llegando a la misteriosa "Habitación 401".

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Cuando Ren se entera de que a Eri solo le quedan unos días de vida, decide convertirse en el último Jinete que la salve, y se lanza a pelear abruptamente y sin tener en cuenta a los demás.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Eri se despierta de un coma prolongado y llama a Ren, quien se comporta de manera imprudente para luchar.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Yui es arrastrada al Mirro-World y Ryuki la persigue. ¿Por qué Yui fue arrastrado allí? ¿Quién es el Rider involucrado en esto?

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Eri se encuentra en un estado en el que se desconoce cuándo volverá a entrar en coma, incluso después de un breve despertar.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Tiga traiciona y derrota fácilmente a su compañero Alternativo. En medio de esto, Ren, que perdió a Eri, volvió a ponerse de pie después de enterarse de que Yui era el objetivo.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: El profesor Kagawa explica cómo es ser un héroe mientras intenta mantener a raya a la indomable Taiga.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Satoru Tojo es aún más devoto de Kagawa, quien trató de convertirse en un héroe incluso sacrificando a su familia.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Ren y Shinji intentan proteger a Yui, mientras que Kagawa y Satoru intentan matarla. Mientras tanto, Imperer intenta promocionarse.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Yui, que controlaba a los monstruos, desapareció en Mirro World.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Con la muerte de su padre, Imperer heredó una inmensa fortuna. Se había convertido en Jinete para ganarse bien la vida y lo consiguió de la noche a la mañana.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: aiga, que cree que está más cerca de ser un héroe porque derrotó a Imperer, vuelve a desafiar a Ouja. A pesar de que Shinji está deprimido, Yui y los demás hacen los preparativos navideños.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Shinji juró convertirse en un Jinete para salvar a otros. Pero, la crisis que golpeó a Yui no se trata solo de destruir a los monstruos.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Quiere salvar a Yui, cuyo destino es desaparecer cuando cumpla 20 años. Ren se involucra en una feroz pelea con Shinji, quien se conmueve por su decisión de pelear.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Faltan tres días para el cumpleaños de Yui. Shiro Kanzaki dice que el tiempo se acaba, convoca a los Riders y les pide que peleen la batalla final.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Faltan dos días para el cumpleaños de Yui. Reiko ve a Shinji transformarse. El periódico ORE revela el secreto de los Kamen Riders, causando gran conmoción.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Yui eligió desaparecer por su cuenta. Shinji descubrió su verdadero deseo. Cerca de la muerte, Kitaoka prefiere ajustar cuentas con Asakura en lugar de salir con Reiko.

programme.title: Kamen Rider ZI-O
programme.desc: Tokiwa Sougo es un estudiante normal de tercer año, que nació al mismo tiempo que los Heisei Riders. Lo único extraño de él es su constante sueño de querer ser rey. Un día, Sougo es atacado por un robot rojo gigante.

programme.title: Kamen Rider ZI-O
programme.desc: Geiz, un hombre del futuro ataca a Sougo. Tsukuyomi, una chica que también dice que viene del futuro lo ayuda. Sin entender lo que había sucedido, lo sigue un profeta oscuro, llamado Woz.

programme.title: Kamen Rider ZI-O
programme.desc: Geiz y Tsukuyomi comienzan sus misteriosas vidas y descubren que en su escuela había un "juego que no se podía poner a cero". Surgen rumores de tal "Gamer Genius M", que deja su trabajo para perseguir cierto misterio.

programme.title: Kamen Rider ZI-O
programme.desc: El "Gamer Genius M" no es otro que Hojo Emu, que se convierte en Kamen Rider Ex-Aid. Sin embargo, cuando el recién derrotado Another Rider revive, Hojo pierde la memoria y no recuerda haber sido un ex-ayudante.

programme.title: Kamen Rider ZI-O
programme.desc: Geiz, Tsukuyomi y Sougo van a Colégo Amanogawa después de enterarse de la desaparición de estudiantes. Existe la sospecha de que Another Rider está involucrado en el caso.

programme.title: Kamen Rider ZI-O
programme.desc: Dentro del cuerpo de Otro Fourze hay otra forma: Otro Faiz. Takumi Inui, el hombre que vino a detener a Masako Kusaka, aparece en la casa de Sougo. El extraño dúo entre Sougo y Takumi decide seguir el caso más de cerca.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: L'arme du crime
programme.desc: Après la mort par balle d’un flic de Dallas, le coupable impute le crime au neveu innocent de Carlos, Jesse. Walker doit prouver son innocence pour lui sauver la vie.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Un témoin très spécial
programme.desc: Walker doit arrêter le tueur à gages qui a poignardé Trent avant qu’il ne mette la main sur la fille handicapée mentale qui a été témoin de l'attaque.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Monsieur le principal
programme.desc: Après le « suicide » inattendu d’un proviseur d'un lycée qui enquêtait sur un réseau de drogue au sein de son établissement, Walker tente de découvrir la vérité sur la mort de son vieil ami et de rétablir l'ordre sur le campus envahi par les dealers.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Hors circuit (1ère partie)
programme.desc: Walker doit découvrir qui essaie de semer la zizanie dans une équipe amérindienne de course automobile en pleine préparation pour un événement majeur.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Hors circuit (2ème partie)
programme.desc: Lorsque le pilote de la voiture de l'équipe Cherokee est mis à l'écart, Walker doit prendre le volant pour éviter la disqualification de l’équipe.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Catalogue interdit
programme.desc: Pas une minute à perdre pour les Rangers lorsque la nouvelle petite amie de Trivette est enlevée par une bande de trafiquants d’êtres humains sur Internet.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Les eaux de la vengeance
programme.desc: Lorsque qu’Alex et Trivette sont enlevés par l'ennemi juré de Walker et mis dans un réservoir d'eau glacée, Walker vole à leur rescousse.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Frères d'armes
programme.desc: Walker et Trivette tombent des nues lorsqu’ils découvrent que le cerveau d’un trafic de drogues et d’armes est le frère de Trivette avec qui il n’a plus de contacts depuis longtemps.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: La machination
programme.desc: Alors que Walker et Trivette sont sur la piste d'un criminel évadé, C.D. enquête sur la mort suspecte du fils de son ami.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Au sommet de l'échelle
programme.desc: Walker, Trivette et Alex doivent protéger un quartier contre un gang de pyromanes qui intimident les témoins et tentent de tuer les pompiers dans l’exercice de leurs fonctions.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: La bonne parole
programme.desc: Walker et Trivette cherchent à arrêter un usurier qui fait dans les personnalités et exploite le fils d'un ministre.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Au nom du crime (1ère partie)
programme.desc: Walker et Alex sont piégés à bord d’un avion qui s’est écrasé sur un lac isolé et qui est sur le point de couler.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger
programme.desc: Walker et Alex se sont miraculeusement échappé de l’avion qui a coulé au fond d'un lac dans le dernier épisode de la saison précédente, mais ils courent toujours un grand danger.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Menace sur la ville
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un fou énigmatique menace la ville de Dallas de libérer un gaz mortel dans l’air, Walker et son équipe ont 48 heures pour l'arrêter.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Protection rapprochée
programme.desc: Walker et les Rangers doivent protéger un comptable qui a accepté de témoigner contre son ancien employeur, un violent mafieux qui ne reculera devant rien pour faire taire son ancien comptable.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Au nom de la justice
programme.desc: Walker fait face à un défi inhabituel lorsqu'il doit sonder le passé pour réparer une injustice.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Faiseur de veuves
programme.desc: Lorsqu'une famille de brutes prend pour cible un rodéo local et menace Trivette de mort, Walker doit intervenir pour calmer le jeu.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Les requins de la drogue
programme.desc: Gage et Sydney s’infiltrent pour retrouver la sœur de Gage, prise en otage par un célèbre criminel.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Walker connaît la chanson
programme.desc: Walker et les Rangers doivent sauver les sœurs Lynn d'un groupe de voyous déterminés à gagner des millions en piratant la dernière performance de leur carrière de chanteuses.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Opération antidrogue
programme.desc: Lorsque Walker ne parvient pas à empêcher le suicide d’un jeune garçon dans son école, il doit surmonter sa tristesse et sa colère et jouer et faire en sorte que l’école s’améliore.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Mémoire retrouvée
programme.desc: Walker et les Rangers mettent au jour le complot d’une attaque mortelle au gaz sarin sur le pays.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Témoin silencieux
programme.desc: Walker et les Rangers doivent protéger une fille sourde qui a été témoin d'un meurtre.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Les gladiateurs
programme.desc: Walker s’infiltre en tant que détenu dans une prison à sécurité maximale en Arkansas pour enquêter sur des matons qui organisent et filment de violents combats entre prisonniers pour les vendre sur Internet au prix fort.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Aigle blanc
programme.desc: Walker fait face à des ennemis redoutables, à la fois internes et externes, lorsque l’explosion d’une bombe détériore sa vision.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Le miracle de Noël
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode spécial Noël, Walker et son équipe doivent trouver les coupables responsables d’un vol de cadeaux pour les enfants dans le besoin d'une église locale et d’avoir mis le pasteur dans le coma.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Ranger un jour, Ranger toujours
programme.desc: Walker et les Rangers doivent retrouver une bande de voleurs de bijoux qui ont grièvement blessé la fille d'un ex-Ranger lors d'un violent braquage.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Dans la ligne de mire
programme.desc: Walker et les Rangers doivent récupérer un nouveau laser sonique sophistiqué et mortel tombé entre de mauvaises mains.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger
programme.desc: Trivette doit aider une étudiante à prouver l’innocence de son père qui a été mis derrière les barreaux après avoir été accusé de meurtre.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Le Grand Nettoyage
programme.desc: Sammo Law (guest-star Sammo Hung, Le Flic de Shanghaï) vient en aide à Walker et les Rangers pour empêcher des suprémacistes blancs de faire des ravages.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: La Marque du dragon noir
programme.desc: Walker et son équipe doivent empêcher la distribution d'une cargaison massive d'héroïne mortelle dans la ville de Dallas.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: La Couleur de l'intolérance
programme.desc: Pas une minute à perdre pour Walker et son équipe qui doivent empêcher un groupe de suprémacistes blancs de faire exploser des bombes lors d'un rassemblement à Dallas.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 1
programme.desc: New Year's Eve at Leopard's Den. Alice has returned, but the stress of combining work with caring for baby Bobby is causing tension between her and Danny. Liv is furious that Fatani hasn't told his mother about their relationship.

programme.title: Wild At Heart
programme.desc: Danny is having second thoughts about the wisdom of uprooting his new family and ploughing all their money into a business venture that they know next to nothing about.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Work To Do
programme.desc: A successful giraffe capture means everyone is in high spirits, until the arrival of Evan and Olivia's real father, Simon, throws the family into turmoil.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Meerly Evan
programme.desc: Evan lets the mischievous meerkats loose in Rosie's room to cause havoc. Rosie is devastated when they destroy an irreplaceable photograph of her mother and rages at Evan. She decides once and for all to go back to Bristol.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Evan Meets Elli
programme.desc: Rogue young male elephants are rampaging through Leopard's Den and destroying everything the family have built, so Danny introduces a matriarch elephant in the hope that she will calm them down.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Dawn Feeling
programme.desc: At a typically rowdy family breakfast, Rosie is excitedly looking forward to the arrival of her friend Izzy, whilst Danny is concerned about the rumour of ivory poachers in the area. Unnoticed, Miranda the lion cub pads off into the bush.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 1
programme.desc: The Trevanions have been living at Leopard's Den for over a year. The wildlife is roaming freely and the family are settled into African way of life. Business however is not good. With an abundance of game lodges competition is fierce.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 2
programme.desc: It's the grand reopening of Mara and a British wildlife charity is using the event to release a vulture back into the wild. Fatani, the new, young and ambitious manager of Mara has hired Danny as the vet to oversee the release.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 3
programme.desc: Leopard's Den is looking after a sick and orphaned baby elephant called Togo. However, despite Evan and Du Plessis' constant vigil, Togo is dying from a broken heart. Evan is distraught and Du Plessis promises they will look after her together.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 4
programme.desc: Sarah's absence couldn't have come at a worse time for Leopard's Den. Nature Conservation is carrying out their annual inspection and everything has to be tip top. Danny's determined they pass with flying colours and everyone is roped in to help.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 5
programme.desc: Everyone's excited at the prospect of Leopard's Den's new arrival. Bash, Danny's old tutor and Rosie's Godfather, is coming from England to help Danny grow his veterinary practice.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 6
programme.desc: The Trevanions are delighted when Fatani asks Danny to take an aggressive hippo off his hands. As they prepare for its arrival Sarah gets a bit of a shock when her mother Caroline beats the hippo to the post.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 7
programme.desc: Business is looking up at Leopard's Den but Sarah is feeling agitated. Caroline thinks it because Simon, her ex husband and Evan and Olivia's Dad, is arriving from England to get married. But Sarah has other things on her mind.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 8
programme.desc: Danny is undertaking a drugs trial at Leopard's Den. But de-worming wildebeest isn't Caroline's idea of fun. She hates animals and finds the whole business mind-numbingly boring.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 9
programme.desc: Du Plessis is in a foul mood. It's his 60th birthday and he has no intentions of celebrating it. But the Trevanions have other ideas and Caroline is organising a surprise party.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 10
programme.desc: All is quiet at Leopard's Den as Sarah, Evan and Olivia gather at the hospital. Danny has been given the all clear to go home. But Du Plessis is still unconscious and seriously ill. Caroline keeps a tender vigil at his bedside.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 1
programme.desc: New lodges nearly break the family, but they learn that it's the animals which make Leopard's Den a success.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 2
programme.desc: Danny needs an assistant but fails to see that she's right under his nose; Sarah finds out that she needs her mum.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 3
programme.desc: Leopard's Den expands and DuPlessis becomes a grandfather after a close-call with an angry elephant.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 4
programme.desc: Danny and Sarah let their past catch up with them, and Caroline and DuPlessis go shopping for lion-prey.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 5
programme.desc: A white lion brings mixed fortunes to the family and Rosie is asked the big question. Amy Kriel is the last person you expect in Africa.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 6
programme.desc: Caroline's sister Judith tries to help and the drought forces Danny to sell some of his animals. Will Rosie and Max get married?

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 7
programme.desc: The drought finally throws up a fire and the wedding turns into a firefight for everyone. The omens are bad.

programme.title: Wild At Heart
programme.desc: Tragedy strikes and the Trevanians have to decide what future lies ahead of them in these difficult times.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 1
programme.desc: It's a year since we left Leopard's Den and much has changed. The animal hospital has been rebuilt and is now up and running. It's a big day for all the family as Danny has been fighting for custody of Evan and today they will learn the judge's decision.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 2
programme.desc: Danny and Evan's life on the run doesn't start well when Danny falls asleep at the wheel and drives into a ditch. They have to enlist a local farmer, Johann, to winch them out.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 3
programme.desc: Danny is asked by the State Vet to help control an outbreak of rabies in the National Park. When Vanessa is concerned for the animals at Mara, Danny assures her it's a long way away and advises her to continue with business as usual.

programme.desc: Hatério constrói o Coliseu, mas seu trabalho não acabou. O imperador Domiciano ordena que ele acrescente uma complexa rede de túneis subterrâneos, uma maravilha arquitetônica que tem de ficar pronta a tempo para os jogos ou sua vida correrá perigo.

programme.title: Legados da Antiguidade
programme.desc: Veja como os povos antigos viveram suas revoluções industriais. Conheça a inventividade e as técnicas que possibilitaram a construção da maior catedral do mundo e de um porto artificial com uma inacreditável tecnologia subterrânea.

programme.title: Aqui Tem História

programme.title: Construindo um Império

programme.title: Inventos da Antiguidade

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: At a murder scene, investigators find a shoe print, several foreign hairs, and unknown fingerprints. But they believe the most telling piece of evidence is the bite mark on the victim's chest.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A woman's death in Pennsylvania triggers a homicide investigation into another woman's death in North Carolina. The similarities in the cases were striking, and examiners must determine if the suspect's story about accidental drowning is all wet.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A 34-year-old nurse experiences a variety of flu-like symptoms. None of her doctors can discover the cause until she visits the gynecologist for a routine checkup. Then she learns it's something far worse than the flu.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Time of death becomes pivotal after a pregnant woman is found murdered in her air-conditioned bedroom. A striking similarity between her death and an HBO movie gives examiners the clues they need to thaw out the alibi of a cold-blooded killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Police were puzzled by an obscure print found at a crime scene where one man had been killed, and two teenage girls were seriously injured. Neither of the girls could identify their attacker.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A man is found dead in his home, and his ex-wife has a perfect alibi. To determine the time of death, investigators need to know when the victim ate his last meal. An endocrinologist, a forensic botanist, and a short-order cook answer their question.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A union official was executed in his home not long after a strike by the union members. Neither his wife nor anyone in the neighborhood heard any gunshots. It would take a forensic sound test, an electron microscope, and a nightgown to explain why.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A man tells police he shot an intruder who had attacked and murdered his wife. The husband paints a tragic picture and is dubbed a hero. Four years later, forensic evidence leads police to reexamine the motives of this so-called hero.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A police officer accused of killing his estranged wife insists she committed suicide. Investigators say it was murder and that it was physically impossible for the woman to have shot herself.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When firefighters found an entire family dead inside their home, it looked like a murder-suicide, but there were several inconsistent clues in the rubble. Could ballistics, a time card, and some secret audiotapes unravel the mystery?

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Two men were murdered while sleeping in their beds. The next night, arson destroyed a family planning clinic. Investigators wonder whether some shards of glass, paint chips, and a chicken feather could link what appeared to be two separate crimes.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A young TV news producer is raped and murdered in her apartment. Police identify two suspects, but both are cleared of any wrongdoing. The case stalls for more than a year, and then investigators turn to the Commonwealth of Virginia's DNA data bank.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: With no forensic evidence inside a murder scene, investigators were baffled. But they suspected that the victim's dog had witnessed the crime. If she had, forensic scientists would have had to find a way to find out what the dog had seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Police are dispatched to the scene of a shooting and discover the victim's husband is one of their own: a homicide detective who says his wife accidentally shot herself in the head.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: For years, a woman suffered from what appeared to be the unpleasant side effects of lithium, a drug prescribed to treat bipolar disorder. When she died, investigators had to determine if her death was due to natural causes, suicide, or murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A woman was found dead in a ravine, but crucial crime scene evidence had been washed away by severe thunderstorms. Twice, the trail turned cold. Almost 20 years later, an old hat and a chip of stainless steel brought the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Just weeks before a witness is to testify against the man accused of sexually assaulting her, she is murdered in the front yard of her own home. Investigators immediately suspect her attacker, but they don't have enough evidence to prove his guilt.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: For six years, a serial killer prowled the streets of New York City. He wrote letters to the police and the New York Post, indicating he would kill twelve people, one for each astrological sign.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A healthy young man dies mysteriously in his sleep, and toxicology tests reveal a lethal dose of lidocaine in his blood. Investigators find a suicide note and presume he killed himself until a forensic linguist examines the note.

programme.desc: A retired police officer is discovered in his bed, dead of a single gunshot wound to the head. His wife first says the motive was robbery; then she tells police he committed suicide.

programme.desc: The decomposed body of a young woman was discovered in a Bakersfield irrigation canal. If there was trace evidence, it had been washed away.

programme.desc: Arson investigators attempt to determine the cause of a fire in the Kings Cross Underground Station.

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Deltas of the World
programme.sub-title: Irrawaddy Delta: The Magical World of Mangroves
programme.desc: The Irrawaddy Delta in southern Myanmar is home to the most diverse mangrove forests in the world. The forests serve as natural protection against cyclones that regularly strike the region. The Irrawaddy's widely branching tributaries not only provide schools of fish and rich nutrients, but also function as the most important transport route for the people living in the delta. The greengrocer couple U Tin Hlaing and Daw Khin Lay supply the villages downstream with their fresh produce. But they do not go any further than the Meinmahla Kyun Wildlife Sanctuary. From that point on, the river becomes increasingly turbulent, too dangerous for their small, flat boat. The sanctuary is home to a variety of animal species including the rare Irrawaddy dolphins, saltwater crocodiles, birds of prey such as black kites and brahminy kites, migratory birds such as spoon-billed sandpipers, woodcocks, great cormorants and various anatids. Ranger Lha Soe Win and his colleagues regularly patrol the nature reserve to monitor the animal population and make sure the mangroves are no longer illegally logged for firewood. Since the 1970s, the mangrove population has declined by more than 60 percent, with dramatic consequences for the inhabitants of the delta. Cyclone Nargis, the most devastating cyclone to date, claimed the lives of around 130,000 Burmese in 2008. Together with scientists from the conservation charity Flora and Fauna International, the rangers are working on reforesting the mangroves to restore their function as a natural barrier in the future.

programme.title: On Safari
programme.sub-title: Molori Safari, Madikwe Game Reserve, North West Province
programme.desc: Returning to the magnificent Madikwe Game Reserve for her sixth Safari destination, Sika visits MOLORI SAFARI, a boutique Safari Lodge overlooking the Dwarsberg Mountains and the Madikwe Valley. The Lodge is recognised as one of Southern Africa's most Private and Luxurious Safari Lodges and they are proudly actively engaged in ongoing Conservation efforts. A very unique and special feature is the Whiskey and Gin Bar at the secret Hideout where you can enjoy the magnificence of Wildlife only a few feet away from you around the Lodge's waterhole.

programme.title: On Safari
programme.sub-title: Saseka Tented Camp, Thornybush Nature Reserve, Greater Kruger
programme.desc: Sika's seventh Safari destination is situated in the Greater Kruger area. Thornybush was one of the first Private Nature Reserves in South Africa. Set in the North-eastern portion of this Wilderness Paradise, Saseka Tented Camp is positioned on a distinct curve in the Monwana dry riverbed, which gently sweeps through this incredible landscape. A remarkable setting in the Wild that inspired visionary Designers & Architects, Silvio Rech and Lesley Carstens, to create a Safari Lodge that has a strikingly unique layout and finds a superb balance between cutting-edge design, Classical style and truly feeling connected to the outside environment.

programme.desc: Nuair a chì Sionnach mar a tha Feòrag air a beò-ghlacadh le na saor-làithean mìorbhaileach aice anns a’ choille, tha e fhèin airson a dhol air saor-làithean. Chan eil Maigheach cho cinnteach mun chùis. Cò choimheadas às dèidh a’ bhothain agus a’ ghàrraidh? Cò ach Tosg is Comhachag! Carson nach rachadh an dithis aca-san air saor-làithean mìorbhaileach anns a’ bhothan? Saoil dè cho mìorbhaileach ’s a bhios na saor-làithean aca uile? Brush really enjoys her holiday in the forest, which makes Fox want to go on one as well! Hare isn’t so sure - who will take care of their den and garden? Well, Tusk and Owl of course! Fox and Hare convince them to stay in their den and have a good break, too. Will everybody’s holiday turn out as 'wonnnnderful' as they hope?

programme.title: Aidan: Balach Beag Muay Thai
programme.desc: Tha Aidan ag ullachachadh airson sabaid mhòr aig Farpais Muay Thai na Cruinne. Aidan prepares to compete in the biggest Muay Thai fight of his life.

programme.title: SpongeBob
programme.desc: Plankton poses as a wish-granting genie. Tha Planctan a’ dol ann an riochd dìnidh a shàsaicheas mhiannan.

programme.title: An Sgoil
programme.desc: Tha sinn air ais ann an Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche airson teirm ùr. Tha tòrr air tachairt thairis air na saor-làithean. Cha robh an là in-sheirbheis cho soirbheachail `s a bha Maighstir Mackle an dùil agus tha Ms Sharpe air nochdadh sna pàipearan-naidheachd ri linn ‘s na thachair aig a’ Mhòd. Our cameras are back at Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche for a new term. A lot has happened over the holidays. The in-service day wasn’t as successful as Mr Mackle had hoped and Ms Sharpe has made the newspapers after what happened at the Mòd.

programme.title: A’ Chùil
programme.desc: Tha Choirstaidh air ais le prògram eile bhon stiùidio aice, A’ Chùil. Sa phrògram seo seallaidh i dhut dòigh sgoinneil air coltas eadar-dhealaichte a thoirt air do chuid aodaich! Choirstaidh presents from her studio A’ Chùil to show you a great way of changing up your clothes.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Local, national and international news from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Rurachd (Foraging)
programme.desc: Mary Ann Kennedy and Lucy Cooke forage for nature’s bounty. Mary Ann heads to Northern Ireland to visit a good friend in County Down.

programme.title: Faodail
programme.desc: Tha Tasglann Fhilm Faodail a’ tarraing aire gu filmichean dhùthchasach Innse Gall bho na 1930an gu na 80an, a bha caillte ach a-nis glèidhte don ghinealach ri teachd. Tha bhana Cinema Sgìre Leantainneach a’ siubhal nan eilean, a’ taisbeanadh fhilmichean sna sgìrean ionadail, le cothrom am faicinn air-loidhne air feadh an t-saoghail. Cuirear aithris bheairteach ùr riutha, a’ buntainn ris a’ Ghàidhealtachd, airson luchd-amhairc an là an-diugh. The Faodail Film Archive celebrates lost indigenous film collections from the 1930s to the 1980s in the Outer Hebrides, preserving the archive for future generations. The Cinema Sgìre Continuing mobile cinema van travels the islands, showcasing footage to local communities, making them accessible globally online, and adding rich new narratives relevant to the Gàidhealtachd for contemporary audiences. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Mas Fhior
programme.desc: Seo an fharpais-cheist far a bheil barrachd air eòlas coitcheann a dhìth gus buannachadh. Le Niall Iain Dòmnallach aig an stiùir cluichidh na sgiobaidhean anns an stiùideo an aghaidh an ochdnar Mas Fhìoraich a tha a’ cluich bhon dachaighean fhèin agus a tha a’ cur nan ceistean. A’ strì an aghaidh na Mas Fhìoraich airson feuchainn air an duais mhòr, tha Ewen is Jonny agus Marley is Denise. Presented by Niall Iain MacDonald, this is the quiz show where more than general knowledge is required to win. Playing from the comfort of their own homes are the Pretenders, and they are the ones posing the questions! Battling them to win the big prize in the studio are Ewen and Jonny, and Marley and Denise. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Fonn mo Bheatha
programme.desc: Ceòl agus còmhradh le Cathy Ann Nic a Phi còmhla ri Cairistiona Cheannadach. Music and chat programme presented by Cathy Ann MacPhee with guest Kristine Kennedy.

programme.title: Serie A (BBC Alba)
programme.desc: Tha sinn ann an Ròimh le ball-coise Eadailteach le Roma a’ cluiche Sassuolo beò ann an Serie A. We head to Rome for live Italian football as Roma face Sassuolo in Serie A.

programme.title: Binneas - Na Trads
programme.desc: Seata cuirme le The Poozies le Wired to the Moon agus Sausage. Clàraichte beò aig Duaisean nan Trads 2025 ann an Obar Dheathain. Concert set performed by The Poozies, featuring the tracks Wired to the Moon and Sausage. Originally recorded live at the 2025 Trad Awards in Aberdeen.

programme.title: Ath-thogail Notre-Dame/Rebuilding Notre-Dame
programme.desc: In the fire, Notre-Dame cathedral lost its light and soul - researchers are working to restore the many things that perished.

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: A chocolate babka is a feast for the eyes as well as the belly! It's a popular dish in Poland and the Ukraine. Tha babka teòclaid taitneach, an dà chuid dhan bhrù agus dhan t-sùil! Tha fèill air anns a' Phòlaind agus anns a' Ucràin. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Na Boireannaich a Thog Glasgow City
programme.desc: The inspiring journey of Carol Anne Stewart and Laura Montgomery, the formidable duo who founded Glasgow City FC in 1998.

programme.title: Na Trads
programme.desc: Màiri Anna NicUalraig agus Alistair Heather leis a’ chuid as fheàrr bho Na Trads 2025 à Talla-ciùil Obar Dheathain. Le ceòl bho Mec Lir, Màiri NicAonghais, Rory Matheson Dance Band, Ellie Beaton agus Ross Miller Band am measg gu leòr eile, agus còmhradh le buannaichean is rionnagan an tachartais – an dà chuid air an àrd-ùrlar agus air cùl gnothaich. Mary Ann Kennedy and Alistair Heather present highlights from the 2025 Trad Awards from Aberdeen Music Hall. Featuring performances from Mec Lir, Mairi MacInnes, Rory Matheson Dance Band, Ellie Beaton and Ross Miller Band amongst others. Plus a catch-up with winners and stars both onstage and behind the scenes.

programme.title: Scottish Women's Premier League (BBC ALBA)
programme.desc: Join us for live SWPL action as top-of-the-table Rangers host current champions Hearts. With Micheal Steele and Clare Gemmell pitch-side from Broadwood Stadium. Thig còmhla rinn airson geama beò bho SWPL le Rangers a th’ aig mullach na lìg a’ cur failte air Hearts a bhuannaich an lìog an-uiridh. Tha a gheama slàn le Mìcheal Steele agus Clare Gemmell ag aithris bho stèideam Broadwood.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Local, national and international news from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Seachd Là
programme.desc: Local, national and international news from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Alleluia!
programme.desc: Prògram sònraichte air DiDòmhnaich Cuimhneachaidh. Salm 124 air a sheinn le Ceòlraidh Ghàidhlig Ghlaschu, an laoidh Nam Aonar le Mo Smuaintinn le Còisir Ghàidhlig Ìleach Ghlaschu agus bidh An t-Urr. Aonghas Mac a' Ghobhainn ag innse mun àite a th' aig creideamh an lùib cogadh is call. Tha am prògram air aithris le Iain MacFhionghain. A special programme for Remembrance Sunday, with Psalm 124 sung by Glasgow Gaelic Choir and the hymn Nam Aonar le mo Smuaintinn by Glasgow Islay Gaelic Choir. Rev Angus Smith describes the part faith plays in war and loss. Presented by Iain MacKinnon.

programme.title: Rathad Ramsay
programme.desc: Ramsay meets singer Mary Ann Kennedy in Ardgour. Although born in Glasgow, Mary Ann discusses how she has made her home in Ardgour and what that means to her. As they walk along Cona Glen, Mary Ann opens up about feeling comfortable in her own skin and how the environment has helped her find peace. She chats about her changing relationship with music and what brings her happiness. San treas sreath de Rathad Ramsay bidh Ramsay MacMahon a’ coinneachadh ri sàr Ghàidheil bho air feadh Alba ‘s iad a’ co-roinn sgeulachdan, cuir luach air nàdar agus a’ cnuasachadh ma beatha. Tha Ramsay MacMahon a’ coinneachadh ri Màiri Anna NicUalraig ann an Àird Ghobhar. Ged a rugadh i ann an Glaschu, innsidh Mairi Anna an luach a tha i cuir air far a bheil i air a dachaigh a steidheachadh. A ’coiseachd tron Chona Ghleann, fuasglaidh Màiri Anna suas ma beachdan air a pearsa fhèin agus mar a tha an àrainneachd mu chuairt air a cuideachadh gus sìth a lorg. Tha conaltradh ann ma caochladh dhàimh le ceòl agus dè dìreach a tha toirt toileachas dhi. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Rùm Gu Rùm, Le Erica
programme.desc: Actress turned interior designer Erica Macpherson takes us on a design adventure throughout the Highlands and Islands. With the help of local craft workers, she finds new ideas for designing old spaces. Tha an cleasaiche, a tha a-nis na dealbhaiche cruthachail thaighean, Erica Nic a’ Phersain, a’ gabhail sgrìob tron Ghàidhealtachd ‘s na h-Eileanan. Le taic bho luchd-ciùird, tha i a’ lorg dhòighean ùra air seann rumanan a thoirt beò. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Alba fon Talamh/Scotland Underground
programme.desc: Calum explores the underground sites of central Scotland. First, author Mairi Kidd introduces him to a lesser known history of Edinburgh below the city streets. Then he ventures under the busy platforms of Glasgow Central Station, where Calum discovers an atmospheric disused Victorian platform. In Dunoon, Calum gets help from his friend Kenny Rankin to access the Paper Caves and find out more about a story that dates back almost 350 years, connecting the Campbell clan with the site. ’S a’ phrògram mu dheireadh, nì Calum rannsachadh air làraich fon talamh ann am meadhan na h-Alba. Innsidh an t-ùghdair, Màiri Kidd, dha mun eachdraidh fo shràidean Dhùn Èideann air nach eil mòran eòlach. Fo àrd-ùrlairean trang Stèisean Rèile Meadhan Ghlaschu, gheibh Calum lorg air àrd-ùrlar iongantach, neo-chleachte bho linn Bhictòiria. Ann an Dùn Omhain, bheir a charaid, Coinneach MacFhraing, cuideachadh do Chalum gus Uamhan nam Pàipear a ruighinn agus tuilleadh ionnsachadh mu sgeulachd bhon t-seachdamh linn deug a tha a’ ceangal na Caimbeulaich ris an t-sreath uamhan seo. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Rurachd (Foraging)
programme.desc: Mary Ann Kennedy and Lucy Cooke forage for nature’s bounty. Mary Ann heads to Northern Ireland to visit a good friend in County Down.

programme.title: Seirm
programme.desc: Prògram de cheòl traidiseanta agus freumhach air a lìbhrigeadh le Màiri Anna NicUalraig. Air fhilmeadh aig àm Celtic Connections 2024 agus a’ taisbeanaidh chlàraidhean is chòmhraidhean a chaidh a dhèanamh a dh’aona ghothach airson Seirm, chìte cuid den luchd-ciùil a b’ fheàrr a bha aig an fhèis, leithid Kathryn Tickell & The Darkening, Eòghann MacEunraig, Genticorum, TEUD & Kaïa Kater. Traditional and roots music show presented by Mary Ann Kennedy. Filmed during Celtic Connections 2024, Seirm showcases bespoke recordings and conversations with some of the best artists appearing at the festival. This episode features performances from Kathryn Tickell & The Darkening, Ewen Henderson, Genticorum and intimate session recordings with TEUD & Kaïa Kater. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Ciad-fàthan nan Creutairean/Wild Senses
programme.desc: Rannsachadh air na dòighean annasach a tha fradharc bheathaichean air leasachadh. An exploration of the strange evolution of animal vision.

programme.title: Skipinnish Aig A' Chaisteal
programme.desc: Skipinnish le The Island ann an cuideachd na mìltean de luchd-leantainn aig cuirm-chiùil a’ comharrachadh 25 bliadhna de Skipinnish, bho Chaisteal Dhùn Èideann. Skipinnish perform The Island in front of thousands of fans at a concert celebrating 25 years of the band, from Edinburgh Castle.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Ladybird & Bee/Daolag-bhreac is Seillean
programme.desc: Tha Daolag-bhreac is Seillean ag ionnsachadh dè tha gabhail àite fon talamh – air leth inntinneach! Daolag-bhreac and Seillean are learning what happens underground - really interesting!

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha a’ ghrian a’ deàrrsadh ‘s tha Ooona'son dhol a dh’iasgach. Tha May ag aontachadh cluich cuide ri Baba ach tha Baba a’ diùltadh faiche nan gràineag fhàgail gus an dùisg Spiky bho chadal-geamhraidh! It’s a beautiful day and Oona wants to practise fishing. May offers to play with Baba, who refuses to leave the hedghog burrow as he wants to wait until Spiky wakes from his hibernation!

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha Oona daonnan ann an cabhag ach tha Papa airson sealltainn dhi gum bi buthaidean a' gabhail cùisean air an socair. Saoil an tig aice air ionnsachadh rudan a dhèanamh ann an ‘Dòigh na Buthaide? Oona is forever in a hurry to learn and get things done, but Papa wants to show her that puffins tend to approach things in a slow and steady fashion. Will Oona master the ‘Way of the Puffin?’

programme.title: Boban is Fuigheag
programme.desc: Nuair tha Fuigheag acrach a’ chiad char sa mhadainn, tha e feumach air biadh. Ach ciamar a gheibh e sin ‘s Boban na shuain chadail? When Fuigheag is hungry first thing in the morning, he needs food. But how will he get some with Boban fast asleep?

programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets
programme.desc: Le cuideachadh bho Burtaidh, tha Sif a’ toirt Pipp agus Bran air dàn-chuairt fèill spòrs. Ziff leads Pipp and Button on a fairground adventure with help from faithful Bertie.

programme.title: Sionnach agus Maigheach (Fox & Hare)
programme.desc: Tha Sionnach airson ’s gum bi co-là-breith sònraichte aig Maigheach. Tha cuireadh aig Comhachag is Tosg, fhad ’s a bheir iad prèasant brèagha thuice, leithid dìthean le fàileadh cùbhraidh. Chan eil sin cho furasta ’s a shaoileas iad. Fhad ’s a tha iad trang a’ lorg nam prèasantan tha Maigheach air bhioran ’s I a’ feitheamh gus an tòisich am pàrtaidh co-là-breith aice. Fox wants to give Hare the best birthday ever. Owl and Tusk are invited, but only if they bring a nice present, like a beautifully scented flower. But that is not quite as easy as it seems. All the while Hare is kept waiting for her birthday party to start.

programme.title: Pompon Am Mathan Beag/Pompon Little Bear
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Pompon 's a phàrantan ag ullachadh 'son turas air falbh, feumaidh Pompon tighinn gu co-dhùnadh air dè tha riatanach a thoirt leis sa bhaga aige. When Pompon and his parents prepare to go on a trip, Pompon must come to a decision as to what is essential for him to take in his bag.

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Eilidh NicCarmaig a’ leughadh Famh agus Èirigh-na-grèine. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh le Jeanne Willis agus a dhealbhachadh le Sarah Fox-Davies. Chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Dòmhnall Iain MacLeòid. A bedtime story for young children. Eilidh Cormack reads Famh agus Èirigh-na-grèine by Jeanne Willis, illustrated Sarah Fox-Davies and translated into Gaelic by Donald John MacLeod.

programme.title: SpongeBob
programme.desc: Heat-loving hippies move into Mr Krabs' soup vat! Tha sgioba an tòir air blàths a’ lorg dachaigh anns a’ bhrot aig Mgr. Crùbag.

programme.title: An Sgoil
programme.desc: Tha sgrudaire sgoile air nochdadh aig Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche agus chan eil Maighstir Mackle neo na tidsearan deiseil air a shon. Chan eil cùisean a’ coimhead ro mhath do Mhaighstir MhicFhraing ach tha Maighstir Strachan air a chasan, neo co-dhiù aona chois a lorg. Dè as urrainn a dhol ceàrr?! There’s a surprise visit from a school inspector at Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche. It’s not looking good for Mr MacFhraing, although Mr Strachan seems to have found his feet, well one foot at least. What could possibly go wrong?!

programme.title: Flix
programme.desc: Nuair tha Greta an cù a’ cèilidh air an sgoil, tha Flix airson a bhith taiceil dhi. Gu mì-fhortanach tha iad glè mhì-mhodhail nuair a tha ‘ad còmhla. Tha seo ag adhbharachadh trioblaid coin-cait ach the feum air fuasgladh cait-coin. When Greta the dog visits the school, Flix wants to be helpful to her. Unfortunately, they’re very badly behaved when together. This causes a dog-cat problem so what’s needed is a cat-dog solution!

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan/Bottersnikes and Gumbles
programme.desc: Tha Sona air a bhith trang a’ fàsgadh dhearcan ach tha e air cus den t-sùgh òl – tha sin ga fhàgail nas beòthail’ ‘s nas toilicht’ na bha e o chionn fhada. Abair gu bheil deagh ghumbladh a’ gabhail àit’! Sona has been busy pulping berries but he’s drunk too much of the juice - this has made him livelier and happier than he’s been for quite a while. There’s a lot of Gumbling taking place!

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan/Bottersnikes and Gumbles
programme.desc: Tha an dithis mhealltair – Merri is Seonaidh – ri miastadh. Nuair a tha ’ad a' toirt seachad gheallaidhean nach meall ’ad na Gumbalan, tha ’ad a' tionndadh gus feuchainn ris a’ char a thoirt às na Bògaisean. Saoil ciamar a thèid dhaibh? The two tricksters, Merri and Seonaidh, are up to no good. When they promise not to trick the Gumbals, they turn to playing mischief on the Bògaisean. How will they get on?

programme.title: Fillte
programme.desc: Fillte travels throughout Scotland, visiting the country’s finest woven craft producers. Tha Fillte a siuhbail fad Alba a lorg an obair-laimhne is fhearr, sa luchd-ciùird fighe a chruthaich e.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: We meet Gaelic learner Caroline Quinn from Trinidad and Tobago, while Calum Maclean is in Portmahomack, Easter Ross, learning about his heritage.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Mas Fhior
programme.desc: Farpais-cheist do-chreidsinneach... Mas Fhìor! Le ochdnar Mas Fhìoraich a’ cluich bhon dachaighean fhèin, ’s iad an fheadhainn a chuireas na ceistean agus na freagairtean. An urrainn do Isla is Hamish agus Jamie is Liam a tha a’ cluich bhon stiùideo a’ chùis a dhèanamh orra airson an duais mhòr a bhuannachadh? A quiz show that is pretty unbelievable! Eight Pretenders play from the comfort of their own homes and hold all the questions and answers to this quiz. Can Isla and Hamish, or Jamie and Liam in the studio beat the Pretenders for a chance to win a cash prize? In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Trusadh
programme.desc: Tha Cathy Nicdhòmhnaill a’ bruidhinn ri clann a’ mhansa an là an-diugh. Cathy Macdonald talks to children of the manse.

programme.title: An Clo Mor
programme.desc: The arrival of potential Norwegian investor Johan throws a cat among the pigeons as age old family secrets and resentments come to the fore. The MacSween clan soon begin to realise that the mill is in worse shape than they thought and Seumas makes a surprise announcement to save the mill. Tha ruighinn, an neach-tasgaidh Nirribheach Johan a’ cur a' chiùil air feadh na fìdhle. Tha rùintean-dìomhair agus seann nàimhdeas an teaghlaich a’ togail ceann aon uair eile. Chan eil e a’ toirt fad sam bith mus tuig teaghlach MhicSuain gu bheil a’ mhuileann ann an staid fada nas miosa na bha iad an dùil agus tha a’ bheachd a th’ aig Seumas airson a’ mhuileann a shàbhaileadh a’ cur iongnadh orra uile. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Am Balla (The Wall)
programme.desc: Tha Ramsay MacMahon a’ dol air turas gus faighinn a-mach mun chrìoch eadar an Spàinn agus Moroco. Ann an Ceuta tha feansa àrd a’ sgaradh Afraga agus an Roinn Eòrpa agus dha mòran is e seo an geata chun na Roinn Eòrpa. Coinnichidh Ramsay ri imrichean a tha air a h-uile càil a tha aca a chuir ann an cunnart is iad a’ dol tarsainn air a’ bhalla an tòir air beatha nas fheàrr. Cluinnidh e bho luchd-còmhnaidh ionadail Ceuta a tha beò fo sgàil teannachadh poilitigeach agus coinnichidh e ri daoine a bhios ag obair gus an fheadhainn as motha a th’ ann an cunnart a chuideachadh. Ramsay MacMahon goes on a journey to find out about the border between Spain and Morocco. In Ceuta, a high fence separates Africa and Europe, and for many, this is the gateway to Europe. Ramsay meets migrants who have risked everything to cross the wall in the hope of a better life. He hears from local residents who live with the political tensions and meets people who work to help the most vulnerable. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Binneas - Na Trads
programme.desc: Seata cuirme le The Poozies le Wired to the Moon agus Sausage. Clàraichte beò aig Duaisean nan Trads 2025 ann an Obar Dheathain. Concert set performed by The Poozies, featuring the tracks Wired to the Moon and Sausage. Originally recorded live at the 2025 Trad Awards in Aberdeen.

programme.title: OMC!
programme.desc: Sketch show featuring a collection of comic characters and spoofs. Written by and starring the very best in emerging and established comic talent. Featuring Iain Beggs, Darren Maclean, Carina Macleod, Claire Frances MacNeil, Hannah McKirdy, Lana Pheutan and David Walker. Includes the latest updates from the ferry office, a recipe with a difference, and red hot passion finds physical expression via a clown love triangle. Anns an ceithreamh prògram bho shreath ùr OMC! chì sinn tuilleadh sgeidsichean loma-làn charactaran èibhinn, suidheachaidhean neònach agus ‘spoofs’ gun shamhail bho na sgriobhadariean is cleasaichean as fheàrr a th’ann. Gheibh sinn an turas sa beachd car eadar-dhealaichte airson reasabaidh, tha cridhe Doodles an cleasaiche a’ briseadh agus, ’s e cheist as motha an t-seachdan sa, am bidh an aiseig a’ seòladh? In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Singer-Songwriters at the BBC
programme.desc: The celebration of the singing songwriting troubadours of the 1960s and 70s continues with a further trawl through the BBC archives for timeless and classic performances. Tom Paxton starts proceedings with a rare black and white performance of his classic song The Last Thing on My Mind filmed in 1964. Also making an appearance is the 'fifth Beatle', Harry Nilsson, with a performance from his BBC concert in 1972. Other gems from this year include Canadian Gordon Lightfoot, songwriting duo Gerry Rafferty and Joe Egan as Stealers Wheel and the most popular acoustic act of the 1970s, the gentle, bespectacled John Denver. From the Basil Brush Show in 1973, Ronnie Lane and Slim Chance make a surprise appearance. Californian Beach Boy Bruce Johnston offers a sublime version of Disney Girls, and Joan Armatrading injects a bit of brio on the Old Grey Whistle Test. Rounding it all off is six-time Grammy winner Billy Joel.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: David Jensen and John Peel present the pop chart programme, first broadcast on 10 November 1983. Features Musical Youth, Adam Ant, Eurythmics, Limahl, The Cure and Billy Joel.

programme.title: Top of the Pops

programme.desc: The BBC's 2025 ghost story for Christmas, Mark Gatiss's adaptation of EF Benson's The Room in the Tower. It's 1944, and while sheltering during an air raid, Roger strikes up a conversation with Verity, a Wren. When he asks if she dreams, he begins to recount the haunting vision that has followed him for most of his life: a recurring dream of a mysterious house, a silent family on the lawn and an unseen, unidentified terror lurking in the room in the tower. But when he is invited to stay at a country estate eerily similar to the one in his dreams, and is assigned the very same room, he becomes increasingly disturbed as his nightmares begin to become reality. What is really waiting for him in the room in the tower?

As they settle into a small cottage in a quiet village, they soon find their idyll overshadowed by the superstitious warnings of their housekeeper and the legend of two marble tomb effigies who are said to rise each year and walk. Jack dismisses this is as mere folklore. But as the fateful night draws near, he makes a terrifying discovery. And back at the cottage, Laura is all alone...

programme.title: A Ghost Story for Christmas

And occupying the rooms between them is the strange and exotic Edward Bellingham, whose unnatural researches into the secrets of ancient Egypt are the talk of the college. Can Bellingham’s experiments truly bring the breath of life to the horrifying bag of bones that is the mysterious Lot No 249?

Guiding us on a tour of the castle and its remarkable collection of artworks, Lucy brings to life the spectacular masque held by Cavendish to win the favour of King Charles I. programme.title: Remembers...
programme.desc: In 1964, a young Steven Berkoff was cast in one of his earliest screen roles, as a junior player in Hamlet in Elsinore, a BBC co-production with Danish television. Shot in Denmark by director Philip Saville, it starred Christopher Plummer as Hamlet and Michael Caine, in his only Shakespeare role, as Horatio. Here, Berkoff shares his memories of the production and how he got involved, gives his verdict on how the film stands up today and describes - as only he can - the excitement and inspiration he felt from watching Plummer and Caine at work.

programme.title: A Ghost Story for Christmas
programme.desc: Sweden, 1863. A country not much visited by Englishmen. An exception is the inquisitive Mr Wraxhall, whose innocent rummaging through the archives of the noble de la Gardie family takes a sinister turn. Wraxhall becomes fascinated by the long-dead founder of the dynasty, the fearsome Count Magnus, a tyrannical ruler who dabbled in alchemy and who once made a strange journey to the Holy Land on most unholy business. Despite the warnings of his hosts, Wraxhall is drawn ever deeper into the Count’s dark world and discovers that the dreaded aristocrat may not lie easy in his tomb...

programme.title: A Ghost Story for Christmas
programme.desc: 1923. Edward Williams, gentleman and amateur golfer, lives an untroubled life as the curator of a small university museum. His speciality is the topography of the British Isles. So when an art dealer sends him details of an interesting engraving - a mezzotint - of an old country house, he’s intrigued. When the picture arrives, however, it seems perfectly ordinary - until Williams notices a figure in the picture where there was none before. A cloaked figure, with a skull-like head and legs that are horribly thin. Soon, within the mezzotint, the figure seems to be on the move across the moonlit lawn towards the house with murderous intent. Long-forgotten secrets rise to the surface as Williams and his friends summon all the rational forces at their command to confront the impossible.

programme.title: A Ghost Story for Christmas
programme.desc: Adaptation of a ghost story by MR James. 1684. John Martin is on trial for his life. Facing him, the infamous 'hanging judge' George Jeffreys. However, this is not a cut-and-dried murder case.

programme.title: A Ghost Story for Christmas
programme.desc: Mark Gatiss brings the Christmas ghost story tradition back to life with The Dead Room, the tale of a long-running radio horror series of the same name. Simon Callow (Victoria & Abdul, Shakespeare in Love, Four Weddings and a Funeral) plays Aubrey Judd, the veteran presenter of the series and national treasure, who finds that he must adapt to changing times and tastes. But whatever happened to the classic ghost stories? The good old days?

programme.title: The Story of Scottish Art
programme.desc: The 18th century heralded the greatest blossoming of Scottish artistry in its history. The most powerful and influential figures in Britain clamoured to have their portraits painted by Allan Ramsey and Henry Raeburn, and their houses designed by Robert Adam. They stood in awe at the epic Highland landscapes of Horatio McCulloch and wept at the sensitive genre paintings of David Wilkie. Scots artist Lachlan Goudie explores how the intellectual revolution of the Enlightenment and the classical influence of the continent gave these artists the confidence and the inspiration to forge a whole new artistic landscape. From dusty storerooms of Edinburgh to the dazzling antiquities of ancient Rome, this is a journey of startling contrasts - between the past and the future, between the forces of reason and romance, between Presbyterian restraint and unfettered emotion. Out of the ashes of the Reformation, a new culture identity was beginning to emerge, and it was built on art.

programme.title: Classic Mastermind

programme.title: The Sky at Night

programme.title: Joan Sutherland

programme.title: Metalworks!
programme.desc: Art historian and curator Tobias Capwell celebrates the great age of armour. Referencing the unstoppable rise of the Royal Almain Armoury at Greenwich, he tells the forgotten story of how Henry VIII fused German high technology with Renaissance artistry in the pursuit of one aim - to become the very image of the perfect knight. Using the talents of foreign craftsmen and his court artist Hans Holbein, Henry transformed himself into a living metal sculpture. His daughter Elizabeth I further exploited that image, making her courtiers parade before her in the most innovative and richly decorated works ever commissioned in steel.

programme.title: Simply Nigella
programme.desc: Packed with new recipes and tips designed to make our busy lives easier, Simply Nigella proves that whatever the occasion, food, in the eating and the making, should always be pleasurable. This episode is all about dishes that marry the comfort of the familiar with the freshness of the new, like Nigella's grown-up take on a family favourite - fluffy oat pancakes with a raspberry and honey syrup. For a fun lunch, there is a riff on the classic caesar salad. A casual supper with friends sees Nigella serving a green-inspired feast of squid and orzo pasta, complete with the Greek dessert of old rag pie - a sweet and savoury twist on a cheesecake. And finally, Nigella's take on a rice bowl with ginger, radish and avocado celebrates a few choice ingredients, resulting in a dish that is calming and uplifting to look at, as well as to eat.

programme.title: The Football Interview
programme.desc: The Football Interview sees the biggest names in sport and entertainment join host Kelly Somers for bold, in-depth conversations about the nation’s favourite sport. We explore mindset and motivation, reflect on defining moments and career highs, and discuss personal insights. It’s a chance to show an honest, human and sometimes surprising side to familiar faces. At the heart of this is Kelly Somers – one of the most trusted, versatile and authentic voices in sports broadcasting. Kelly brings a brand of warmth and relatability that resonates with both athletes and audiences. What sets her apart is her ability to dig deeper with a sensitive approach, creating a space where athletes feel comfortable being open, honest and at times vulnerable. Each episode sees Kelly draw out stories and insight from the player behind the name about the beautiful game, their origins and values, and a look-ahead to the future from a sporting and personal perspective. She takes her subjects on a journey – and takes the viewer with her.

Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. programme.desc: Whether you were wading through floods or struggling through a heatwave, 2026 was the year when you could hardly miss our extreme weather. Temperatures in the summer topped 30C for 33 days in a row. Months earlier, some parts of the UK saw 40 consecutive days of rain. The BBC's climate editor Justin Rowlatt investigates the impact of climate change on our weather. He speaks to scientists who warn that hotter summers and wetter winters are likely to become more typical, and looks at if enough is being done to adapt our towns and cities to the changing climate. Justin asks, as the cost of living continues to bite, are governments under pressure to ditch some green policies, or do they remain committed to tackling climate change?

programme.title: This City Is Ours
programme.desc: The tragic events of the party send shock waves through the Phelans. As dangerous secrets threaten to come to light, Michael is forced to make a difficult confession to Diana. Meanwhile, unseen dangers close in, and it becomes clear no-one is safe.

programme.title: Simply Nigella
programme.desc: Packed with new recipes and tips designed to make our busy lives easier, Simply Nigella proves that whatever the occasion, food, in the eating and the making, should always be pleasurable. This episode is all about dishes that marry the comfort of the familiar with the freshness of the new, like Nigella's grown-up take on a family favourite - fluffy oat pancakes with a raspberry and honey syrup. For a fun lunch, there is a riff on the classic caesar salad. A casual supper with friends sees Nigella serving a green-inspired feast of squid and orzo pasta, complete with the Greek dessert of old rag pie - a sweet and savoury twist on a cheesecake. And finally, Nigella's take on a rice bowl with ginger, radish and avocado celebrates a few choice ingredients, resulting in a dish that is calming and uplifting to look at, as well as to eat.

programme.title: The Football Interview
programme.desc: The Football Interview sees the biggest names in sport and entertainment join host Kelly Somers for bold, in-depth conversations about the nation’s favourite sport. We explore mindset and motivation, reflect on defining moments and career highs, and discuss personal insights. It’s a chance to show an honest, human and sometimes surprising side to familiar faces. At the heart of this is Kelly Somers – one of the most trusted, versatile and authentic voices in sports broadcasting. Kelly brings a brand of warmth and relatability that resonates with both athletes and audiences. What sets her apart is her ability to dig deeper with a sensitive approach, creating a space where athletes feel comfortable being open, honest and at times vulnerable. Each episode sees Kelly draw out stories and insight from the player behind the name about the beautiful game, their origins and values, and a look-ahead to the future from a sporting and personal perspective. She takes her subjects on a journey – and takes the viewer with her.

His Majesty will be joined on Whitehall by senior members of the royal family and leading UK politicians, alongside representatives of the armed forces, the Commonwealth and faith communities for the two-minute silence at 11 o’clock and the National Service of Remembrance. programme.title: War Horse
programme.desc: Wartime drama. It is 1914, and struggling Devon farmer Ted Narracott buys a remarkable but unsuitable horse at auction. His son Albert names him Joey and, under pressure from their unscrupulous landlord, somehow trains Joey to work the farm. But when war breaks out, Joey is requisitioned by the army to serve at the front and begins a remarkable adventure that takes him far from Albert and the fields of Devon.

programme.title: Planet Earth Live
programme.desc: Sam, Sophie and Sybil are three tiny black bear cubs who have just emerged from their den in the Northwoods of Minnesota. But this spectacular wilderness is full of threats - wolves and coyotes roam the forest looking for stray cubs, the weather can be dangerously unpredictable bringing blizzards and forest fires, and every year, some of the black bears are killed by humans. Survival depends entirely on the experience of their mother and how well they learn the skills she teaches them. With the help of bear expert Dr Lynn Rogers, Julia Bradbury explores the woods, learning about the lives of the black bears and the particular trials facing these three vulnerable little cubs. Sam, Sophie and Sybil must follow their mother's lead closely if they are going to survive in this tough and unforgiving wilderness, and make it through this critical month.

programme.title: Blue Planet III
programme.desc: In the tropical seas, year-round sunshine has created the perfect conditions for the ocean’s richest habitats to flourish, but survival takes remarkable and surprising ingenuity.

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Figures for the first seven months of the year show milk production in Northern Ireland is heading for a record year. But fluctuating prices, rising costs and the ever-present threat of disease have left many dairy businesses under financial pressure. Alongside local farmer Emily McGowan, Charlotte Smith and Adam Henson explore how dairy farmers across County Antrim, one of Northern Ireland's most productive dairy regions, are turning to tech and innovative business models to build a more resilient future. Adam also introduces this year’s BBC Food and Farming Awards Countryfile Young Countryside Champion nominees.

programme.title: The Reluctant Vampire
programme.desc: The day of Val’s initiation ceremony approaches, and he still has no idea how he’ll pass the vampire test. When his final plan doesn’t work out, he realises he can no longer live a double life and is faced with the ultimate dilemma. Should he come clean and risk everything for the chance of a human life or sacrifice who he really is for the sake of his family?

programme.title: Strictly Come Dancing
programme.desc: It’s results time, and the couples wait to find out if they’ll be heading back to the training rooms to learn another new dance. programme.title: Dashcam Justice
programme.desc: A pedestrian hurls himself at a car, then blames the driver. But the dashcam reveals a murkier story. In Widnes, horse rider Jayne Scotson films a frighteningly close pass, while in Liverpool, a van mounts the pavement to dodge a bin lorry, and could take out innocent bystanders. Police and fraud investigators reveal how footage recorded by ordinary people helps them uncover the truth and pursue justice.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Dion time travels back to the 70s in Nottinghamshire, and it all feels very familiar. Martin is loving his surroundings in Bath, and Jacqui sees beyond the work that needs to be done in Norfolk to appreciate the potential.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Wooden shoe lasts are a common sight at antiques fairs, but do you know how they’re made? Natasha Raskin Sharp visits the workshop of cordwainer Payson Muller, originally a stonemason, who turned his talents to making bespoke shoes on hand-carved shoe lasts. He creates them from beech boughs before refining their shape using a knife and rasp. Hoping to cut a few deals of their own are two teams of bargain hunters, shopping for collectibles at Wetherby Racecourse. In blue are couple Martin and Nasreen, and their opponents are married duo Lisamarie and Jamie. Nasreen’s keen eye spots an ornate Russian caviar bowl and spoon, but the price tag is an eye-watering £600. Elsewhere, Jamie comes across a wacky glass vase that resembles a famous artist’s work, but Philip Serrell thinks it’s no masterpiece. At the sale, both teams hope for big profits, but all they can do is watch as their items go under auctioneer Caroline Hawley’s hammer.

programme.title: BBC News at One
programme.desc: The latest national and international news from the BBC.

programme.title: Money for Nothing
programme.desc: Jacqui Joseph is patrolling the forecourt of Altrincham recycling centre in Greater Manchester, hoping to find three items that are packed with potential and give them the chance to shine once more. She finds a pair of folding chairs, an old washstand and a collection of glass bottles. Upholsterer Simion Hawtin-Smith and upcycler Sarah Parmenter set to work helping Jacqui transform her finds, but will all three projects produce profits?

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Having spent many happy family holidays in Cornwall, a couple from Hertfordshire now want to make England’s most south-westerly county their permanent home, and Steve Brown is just the man to help them realise their dream. The trio also meet a local ceramicist and take part in a pottery throwdown.

programme.title: The Bidding Room
programme.desc: Nigel Havers presides as members of the public with interesting items to sell come face to face with five dealers who bid against each other to try to bag themselves a bargain. Before facing the dealers, each seller has their item valued by auctioneer Simon Bower. Simon also gives them top tips on the history and key characteristics of their piece, so that when they enter the bidding room, they have all the information they need to try to haggle the best possible price from the dealers. All the dealers are spending their own money but have no idea what the sellers have brought in.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the quiz show where a team of four – in this episode, friends Martin, Robyn, Paul and Wayne – take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.title: Pointless
programme.desc: Alexander Armstrong is joined by co-host Sally Phillips for the brainy quiz where the contestants try to score as few points as possible by plumbing the depths of their general knowledge to come up with the answers no-one else could think of.

programme.title: Dashcam Justice
programme.desc: A pedestrian hurls himself at a car, then blames the driver. But the dashcam reveals a murkier story. In Widnes, horse rider Jayne Scotson films a frighteningly close pass, while in Liverpool, a van mounts the pavement to dodge a bin lorry, and could take out innocent bystanders. Police and fraud investigators reveal how footage recorded by ordinary people helps them uncover the truth and pursue justice.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Dion time travels back to the 70s in Nottinghamshire, and it all feels very familiar. Martin is loving his surroundings in Bath, and Jacqui sees beyond the work that needs to be done in Norfolk to appreciate the potential.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Wooden shoe lasts are a common sight at antiques fairs, but do you know how they’re made? Natasha Raskin Sharp visits the workshop of cordwainer Payson Muller, originally a stonemason, who turned his talents to making bespoke shoes on hand-carved shoe lasts. He creates them from beech boughs before refining their shape using a knife and rasp. Hoping to cut a few deals of their own are two teams of bargain hunters, shopping for collectibles at Wetherby Racecourse. In blue are couple Martin and Nasreen, and their opponents are married duo Lisamarie and Jamie. Nasreen’s keen eye spots an ornate Russian caviar bowl and spoon, but the price tag is an eye-watering £600. Elsewhere, Jamie comes across a wacky glass vase that resembles a famous artist’s work, but Philip Serrell thinks it’s no masterpiece. At the sale, both teams hope for big profits, but all they can do is watch as their items go under auctioneer Caroline Hawley’s hammer.

programme.title: Money for Nothing
